People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- J. Storer Clouston, the author, died 1944.

First publication of the text used: 1918 (SE colophon: 'The Man from the Clouds was published in 1918 by J. Storer Clouston.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1918, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 2013.
- Country of origin (possible countries: the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa): the last person to die, J. Storer Clouston, died 1944. With a term of life + 70 years, the text entered the public domain on 1 January 2015 in these countries. Each of the listed countries has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths, so the exact country, or a simultaneous first publication in two of them, does not change the result.
